result.title: Imperfect Verifiers, Exact Targets: Inference-Time Scaling for Continuous Generation
result.summary: Verifier-guided inference-time scaling uses additional computation to score intermediate states and steer generation toward better outputs. However, imperfect intermediate verifiers can distort sampling, and repeated refinement alone does not ensure recovery of the desired reward-tilted distribution. We introduce Continuous-State Verifier-Guided Backtracking (CS-VGB), an inference-time scaling method for sampling from reward-tilted distributions with continuous generative models through repeated denoising and renoising. With correctly paired denoising and renoising transitions, the stationary distribution of CS-VGB at the clean checkpoint equals the desired reward-tilted target, even when intermediate verifiers are inaccurate. Under stated regularity conditions, CS-VGB converges exponentially to the target despite verifier error, and the expected number of updates needed to reach a clean sample grows only linearly with the number of checkpoints. In analytically tractable settings, we empirically demonstrate that CS-VGB recovers the desired reward-tilted distribution despite verifier error, whereas the compared verifier-based sampling methods fail to recover the target under the same verifier errors. We also instantiate the framework with diffusion models and one-step stochastic posterior maps. Across prompt-guided ImageNet generation, facial-attribute generation on CelebA, and multi-robot planning, recurrent CS-VGB search improves reward and task success as inference budgets grow, with image-generation rewards continuing beyond the observed plateaus of denoising-only baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CS-VGB：对连续状态生成模型在推理期通过反复去噪/重噪与中间状态回溯进行引导采样，并证明在验证器不完美时清洁检查点的稳态分布仍等于目标的 reward-tilted 分布、收敛随检查点数线性增长；在扩散模型和一步后验映射上以图像生成与多机器人规划验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「不完美中间验证器下的回溯式搜索与收敛保证」可能可供核查 LVR 中 LOOK/验证信号可信度、停止决策与计算预算增长下的收益，但对象是连续生成采样而非 VLM latent 推理状态，迁移性需人工判断。
